In this way, one half of a baby's genes come from the baby's mother and one half come from the baby's father.", "reason": "The ACOG page directly explains that a baby's genes come from the egg and sperm that unite during fertilization, supporting the note's claim that genetic contribution comes only from the fertilizing sperm and egg."}

parsed.note_claim: Çocuğun genleri döllenmeyi yapan sperm ve yumurtadan gelir; önceki partnerler genetik katkı yapmaz.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: During fertilization, when the egg and sperm join, the two sets of chromosomes come together. In this way, one half of a baby's genes come from the baby's mother and one half come from the baby's father.
parsed.reason: The ACOG page directly explains that a baby's genes come from the egg and sperm that unite during fertilization, supporting the note's claim that genetic contribution comes only from the fertilizing sperm and egg.
